info.title: Invexa Retail API - extracted modules
info.description: Week 8 (API Modularization and Contract Generation): a versioned OpenAPI contract for the endpoints that have been extracted out of the god routers (routes/core.ts, routes/operations-extension.ts) into their own thin route + command/query service + repository modules. This is NOT a spec for the whole API - most of core.ts/operations-extension.ts's ~180 remaining routes are tracked as extraction backlog in docs/route-ownership-matrix.md and are deliberately not documented here yet, so this contract never silently drifts ahead of what has actually been modularized. Extending it is part of extracting the next module. Week 10 adds the Item Search / Stock Detail / Adjustment-Reversal vertical slice (routes/items.ts) - additive to, not a replacement for, core.ts's existing unpaginated GET /items. Week 13 adds the Week 11 staged-import-lifecycle endpoints (routes/imports.ts) and the Week 12 reporting/exception-dashboard endpoints (routes/reports.ts) to the contract - both existed in code before this week but were not yet documented here (see AGENTS.md's OpenAPI contract row: 'covers only extracted routes... grows as each future module is extracted'). Plan 10/10 (Phase 3-8) adds the virtual bundle/kit endpoints (routes/bundles.ts), the optional two-factor sign-in endpoints (routes/enterprise-auth.ts /auth/2fa/*), the stock reconciliation endpoints (routes/command-center.ts /ops/reconciliation*), and documents the X-Mutation-Id exactly-once replay header (lib/mutation-idempotency.ts) as a shared parameter. Auth catch-up adds sign-in (/auth/login, /auth/send-otp, /auth/verify-otp) and session (/auth/refresh-token, /auth/logout, /auth/logout-all) endpoints. Operations catch-up adds /ops/sync-health, the webhook subscription and delivery endpoints (company scoped), and the approval-request endpoints. Adds the Entity 360 read model and the one-time web handoff used by the native app. Coverage pass: every operation the API serves under /api/v1 is now listed. Operations marked `x-contract-level: path-only` have a verified method, path, parameters and authentication but their request and response bodies are described as free-form objects until each is specified; operations without that marker are fully specified. Auth catch-up adds sign-in (/auth/login, /auth/send-otp, /auth/verify-otp), session (/auth/refresh-token, /auth/logout, /auth/logout-all) endpoints.

IdempotencyKey.name: requestId
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-supplied idempotency key. Mutating endpoints that accept one return the original result on replay instead of double-posting (ADR-006). Most endpoints in this contract take it as a body field, not a query parameter - see each operation.

MutationId.name: X-Mutation-Id
MutationId.description: Exactly-once replay key, created once when the person acts and reused on every retry (including after a restart). 8-128 characters of letters, digits and . _ : -. A retry with the same id and the same request returns the original 2xx response with `Idempotent-Replay: true` and does not run again; a concurrent duplicate gets 409 MUTATION_IN_PROGRESS with Retry-After; the same id for a different request is 422 MUTATION_ID_REUSED.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The stable error shape (ADR-006 / lib/errors.ts's DomainError) that new and extracted code returns. Not yet the shape of every endpoint in the full API - see AGENTS.md's Error catalog row.

error.description: Human-readable message. May change wording without notice - do not branch on it.

code.description: Stable, SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Clients branch on this.

traceId.description: Correlates this rejection to server logs and the audit trail.

LegacyErrorMessage.description: The older, pre-Week-7 error shape most of these endpoints still use for validation/role failures (see each operation's 4xx responses for which shape applies).

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor (the last item's id). Pass back verbatim as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null means no more pages.

reversalOf.description: The id of the movement this one reverses, if any.

ReconciliationStatus.description: Whether StockLedger.onHand for one (lot, location) agrees with the sum of every StockMovement journal row for it - computed live from the canonical journal/projection (ADR-001), the same way scripts/reconcile-stock-journal.mjs does.

qtyDelta.description: Positive to add stock, negative to remove. Never zero.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-generated (e.g. a UUID). Retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of posting again.

duplicate.description: True if this idempotency key had already been posted - the movement/balance below are the ORIGINAL result, not a new post.

type.description: OPENING_STOCK, SALES, PURCHASE, ADJUSTMENT_SET/ADD/REMOVE, or a reversal.

reversible.description: True while the batch is POSTED and is not itself a reversal.

ImportRawRow.description: One staged row before validation - already-parsed JSON, not a raw CSV/file upload (see docs/week11-import-staging-commit-reverse.md's 'Not done').

branchName.description: Required for SALES/SALES_RETURN/OPENING_STOCK - ignored for PURCHASE, which always posts at Head Office.

duplicate.description: true if this file's checksum matched an existing batch - the returned batch is that existing one, not a new one.

breached.description: Open cases whose dueAt has passed.

buildable.description: Whole bundles that can be built from sellable component stock (on hand minus reserved).

configured.description: False when the server has no TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

challengeToken.description: 5-minute single-purpose token; never accepted as an access token.

mismatches.description: Rows whose journal does not add up to the balance. Any value above zero is a breach.

noJournalHistory.description: Legacy balances with no journal at all; a reported baseline, not an alert.

refreshToken.description: Native clients only; browsers use the HttpOnly refresh cookie.

available.description: False when the server runs without a database.

stuck.description: Mutation receipts still IN_PROGRESS past the stale window; never deleted automatically.

valueAtStake.description: Decimal(14,2) in the database, a JSON number on the wire.

entityType.description: ITEM for item smart folders, or TABLE:<tableId> for a web list-page view.

isShared.description: Visible to everyone in the company. Only an Admin can set this.

status.description: ACTIVE suppliers can be ordered from.

unitCost.description: Money, 4 decimal places on the server.

orderMultiple.description: Case pack: suggested order quantities round up to a multiple of this.

price.description: Money, 2 decimal places on the server; always a JSON number.

ok.description: False when any violation has severity BLOCK.

status.description: PENDING, RESERVED, BACKORDERED, FULFILLED, CANCELLED or EXPIRED; shipping and returns are tracked on their own records.

readyToSeal.description: True only when every line is MATCHED exactly and there is at least one line.

unitCost.description: Money; always a JSON number (Decimal on the server).

totalAmount.description: Money; always a JSON number (Decimal on the server).

freightCost.description: Money; always a JSON number (Decimal on the server).

customsCost.description: Money; always a JSON number (Decimal on the server).

insuranceCost.description: Money; always a JSON number (Decimal on the server).

handlingCost.description: Money; always a JSON number (Decimal on the server).

matched.description: True when no line has an exception.

totalAmount.description: Money; always a JSON number (Decimal on the server).

status.description: MATCHED when the three-way match is clean, otherwise EXCEPTION (later states are set by finance workflow).

unitCost.description: Money; always a JSON number (Decimal on the server).

items.description: How many items carry the tag (list only).

priority.description: Set from the value at risk when the case is opened.

valueAtRisk.description: Money; a JSON number (Decimal on the server).

id.description: Stable hash of item, lot and location; not a stored row.

severity.description: EXPIRED < 0 days, CRITICAL <= 7, WARNING <= 30, otherwise UPCOMING.

BlindCount.description: What a Store user or Warehouse picker sees: never the book quantity or the variance, so the count stays blind.

StockCount.description: The full count that reviewers (Admin, Admin user, Branch manager, Auditor) see.

parentCountId.description: Set on a recount: the first count it repeats.

varianceMovementId.description: The ledger movement posted when the count was approved.

denied.description: An explicit deny wins over an allow.

scopeId.description: A location id when the grant is limited to one location.

CompanyProfile.description: A company's own profile. Every company has its own; one company's Admin never reads or changes another's.

isShared.description: Visible to the whole company. Only an Admin can set this.

status.description: CANCELLED once cancelled with the carrier.

disposition.description: Set at inspection; only a RESTOCK disposition ever puts stock back on the ledger.

refundStatus.description: REFUNDED or DENIED once finance has decided; null until then.

code.description: Unique within the location; compared case-insensitively when scanned.

storageClass.description: Matched against the item category when suggesting a putaway bin.

binId.description: A bin id, or the staging bin before putaway.

triggerType.description: What the rule gates, for example PO_APPROVE or TRANSFER_CONFIRM.

valueThreshold.description: Money; a JSON number. At or above it, the action needs an approver.

branchId.description: Limits the rule to one branch of the caller's company; null means company-wide.

sourceDocument.description: For example a PO number or a return request id.

valueAccuracyPercent.description: 100 minus the variance value as a share of counted book value; null when nothing costed was counted.

code.description: Unique within the company (and not across companies).

company.description: The brand / manufacturer, not the tenant.

webhookSecret.description: Returned in full only when the connector is created.

PurchasePlanSuggestion.description: One planned purchase line; the planner adds cover, shortfall and cost figures alongside these.

pickMethod.description: LOT_SCAN, or a pooled (weight) pick where the server chooses the lots.

challengeToken.description: Signed, single-use, 5-minute token that carries the server challenge; send it back with the authenticator response.
